name: Day Close: The Green Room
read_aloud: SAFEROOM CERTIFIED. Midterm Onboarding is complete. Level granted; fruit plate issued. Mandatory briefing follows.
narrator_line: SAFEROOM CERTIFIED. Midterm Onboarding is complete.
layout: A backstage green room: a mirror ringed with half-dead bulbs, folding chairs, a fruit plate that has become something else, a framed photo on the wall.

exits.name: STAFF ONLY door to Z10 (Graduation Stage).
The service corridor (Z S) reached from the stage side.

features.name: Stays open to the end of the floor (house exception, inspired).

quick_run.setup: The party reaches the Green Room as the day ends.
quick_run.decision: Take the Long Rest and open the boxes now, or push on tired?
quick_run.on_success: Long Rest taken, level reached, boxes opened, and Day 2 starts rested.
quick_run.on_failure: They skip the rest; the 24-hour mark rolls the day anyway and they start Day 2 worn.
quick_run.cut_short: Open all boxes at once, lowest tier first, and skip the mirror and photo flavor.

loot.text: Box opening during the Long Rest: all earned boxes at once, lowest tier first (00-overview.md section 8.2).

gm_notes: Strong-model notes stay on the Day page. This stub does not copy if_they_do_something_dumb.
